breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: periodic and Dirichlet (u=0). The ground truth correctly removed the Dirichlet condition, keeping only the periodic one. The generated specification also correctly omits the erroneous Dirichlet condition and only includes the instruction to 'Implement periodic boundary conditions using wrap-around indexing', thus resolving the inconsistency.
